notes.subject: dezɛrɛ (ערבות)
notes.rationale: 'deserts/plains' (KJV 'heavens', from ערבות-shamayim in Ps 68:5) vs 'clouds' (bsb) vs 'deserts' (ylt, asv); aravot literally steppe-plains.

notes.subject: sira jɔ (סלו)
notes.rationale: verb סלל 'cast up a highway' (ylt/asv) vs 'extol/exalt' (kjv/jps); same root, two readings.

notes.subject: ביה / שמו
notes.rationale: 'in Ya is his name' — the short Name embedded beside 'name', a double naming in one clause.

notes.subject: to jamana
notes.rationale: plural imperatives: sing, play, cast up, exult — the verse summons the congregation.

translation: Donkilida walasa ka Elohum ya; donkilida fɔ a tɔgɔ la. Sira jɔ walasa ka min bɛ dezɛrɛ la mara; a tɔgɔ ye ⟨Ya⟩ ye; wuli ka ɲɛ di a ɲɛ.
